title: Hanen og høna i Nøtteskogen
world: Present-day Norway, a Saturday in September on the edge of a small town. Behind a housing co-op of pastel-coloured blocks of flats runs a narrow strip of woods with hazel bushes along a footpath, which the children call the Nut Wood. Nearby lie a playground with a new brushed-steel drinking fountain that only gives water for a code from the park app, a park with a barbecue area and a small wooden kiosk selling ice cream and barbecue charcoal, and a shopping centre with glass doors, an escalator, a goldsmith's, a shoe-repair booth and a hardware shop. Across the ring road lies a farm with a pig behind the barn and a field being harvested.
palette: Early September on a clear, bright Saturday: high blue sky, crisp sunlight and long afternoon shadows, hazel bushes still green with the first yellow leaves, red rowan berries, golden stubble and dust over the fields, and pastel blocks of flats glowing in the sun. Accents: the Rooster's scarlet comb, the Kiosk Boy's bottle-green jacket and gleaming brushed steel.

cast.name: Hanen
cast.description: En handlekraftig og panisk omsorgsperson som løper fra sted til sted for å skaffe det som trengs for å få vann fra fontenen.
cast.look: A proud, sturdy farmyard rooster, snow-white all over with glossy white feathers, a big, floppy, bright scarlet comb and red wattles, a short yellow beak, round, earnest black eyes, strong yellow legs with spurs and a tall, arching tail of long white plumes. He carries himself upright with his chest puffed out, full of courage, and runs with his wings half spread.
cast.portrait: Background: the Nut Wood, with the blocks of flats behind the hazel bushes.

cast.name: Høna (Tuppen)
cast.description: Hanen sin kjære høne som setter et nøtteskall i halsen og trenger vann raskt.
cast.look: A small, round, plump little hen, speckled grey all over with tiny white and charcoal flecks like salt and pepper, with a small neat red comb, a short pale beak, bright round orange eyes, soft fluffy grey feathers on her legs and little grey feet. She has a cheerful, curious, nut-loving look.
cast.portrait: Background: the long grass under the hazel bushes.

cast.name: Kioskgutten
cast.description: Gutten i kiosken ved grillplassen, i grønn jakke og med håret til alle kanter. Han hører på hele regla uten å avbryte, vil ikke ha noe tilbake og har det hanen mangler: hender.
cast.look: A tall, skinny boy of about fifteen with a long, pale face, calm grey-green eyes under thick straight eyebrows, a slightly crooked nose and a shy half-smile, and thick red-brown hair sticking out in all directions. He wears a bottle-green zip-up jacket over a black T-shirt, grey joggers and worn white high-top trainers.
cast.portrait: Background: the open hatch of the little ice-cream and charcoal kiosk in the park.

places.name: the Nut Wood
places.look: A narrow strip of woodland behind a row of five-storey pastel blocks of flats: tall hazel bushes heavy with ripe nuts, a few birches and rowans with red berries, long grass and moss, and a gravel footpath with a bench running along it. Through the trees you glimpse balconies on one side and a playground on the other.

cover.prompt: In the Nut Wood on a sunny September day, the Rooster sprints along the gravel footpath towards the viewer at full tilt, wings half spread and every feather streaming, a fierce, determined look in his eye. Behind him, the Hen lies in the long grass under a hazel bush, watching him go. Pastel blocks of flats rise above the trees against a clear blue sky.
cover.caption: Hanen spurter for å skaffe vann til Tuppen, høna si.
cover.alt: Hanen spurter mot oss langs turstien i Nøtteskogen. Bak ham ligger høna i gresset under en hasselbusk, og over trærne ruver boligblokkene.

illustrations.anchor: Hanen bøyde seg over henne med alle fjærene på stritt.
illustrations.prompt: In the Nut Wood on a sunny morning, seen close at bird height: the Hen lies on her side in the grass under a hazel bush, flapping her wings, her beak wide open without a sound, a half-eaten nut beside her. The Rooster bends over her with every feather on end, about to turn and run. Through the trees beyond, a playground with a shiny brushed-steel drinking fountain.
illustrations.caption: Hanen bøyde seg over henne med alle fjærene på stritt.
illustrations.alt: Høna ligger i gresset under en hasselbusk og kaver med vingene. Hanen bøyer seg over henne med alle fjærene på stritt, og bak trærne skimtes en lekeplass.

illustrations.prompt: At a playground on a sunny day, the Rooster has hopped up onto a new, waist-high drinking fountain of brushed steel and pecks hard at its round button, one eye on the small glowing screen above it, which shows only light. Not a drop comes out. Behind him are a swing set, a sandpit and the pastel blocks of flats.
illustrations.caption: Hanen hadde ikke mobil. Han var en hane.
illustrations.alt: Hanen står oppå en ny drikkefontene i børstet stål på lekeplassen og hakker på knappen. Det kommer ikke en dråpe.

illustrations.anchor: «Du får ikke bånd av meg før jeg får sko av deg», sa gullsmeden.
illustrations.prompt: Inside a bright goldsmith's shop in a shopping centre, a small, grandmotherly goldsmith of about seventy, with silver hair in a neat bun and a light-blue cardigan over a lavender dress, stands barefoot on a round white display podium in the middle of the shop with her arms crossed. At her feet lies a pair of rhinestone sandals, one with a snapped strap. Behind the counter hang rolls of gift ribbon in every colour. The Rooster looks up at her from the floor, breathless.
illustrations.caption: «Rulletrappa tok sandalen min klokka ti. Og gulvet er iskaldt.»
illustrations.alt: En liten, bestemorslig gullsmed står barbeint på en rund utstillingspall med armene i kors. Ved føttene hennes ligger et par glitrende sandaler, og hanen ser opp på henne.

illustrations.prompt: Behind a red barn on a farm across the ring road, a huge pink sow with black spots lies in the mud chewing an apple core, with several more apple cores around her. The Rooster stands at the edge of the mud in front of her snout, talking fast with his wings spread. Beyond the fence, cars stream along the ring road past a zebra crossing, and the blocks of flats stand in the distance.
illustrations.caption: «Jeg har fått epler fra barnehagen hele uka.»
illustrations.alt: Ei stor, flekkete purke ligger i gjørma bak fjøset og tygger på et epleskrott. Hanen står foran trynet hennes og snakker fort. Bak gjerdet går ringveien.

illustrations.anchor: Så løp hanen hjem til blokkene.
illustrations.prompt: In the backyard of the blocks of flats, beside a big heap of split birch logs, a burly caretaker with a bushy black beard, in a navy work jacket and a grey beanie, holds up a bare axe handle with no head on it and shrugs with a helpless face. The Rooster stares up at the empty handle from the top of a log, beak open. Bikes, recycling bins and balconies behind them.
illustrations.caption: Den nye øksa hadde vært «under levering» i tre uker.
illustrations.alt: I bakgården står vaktmesteren foran en haug med bjørkekubber og holder opp et økseskaft uten hode. Hanen stirrer på skaftet fra toppen av en kubbe.

illustrations.anchor: Smeden holdt opp hånda og ristet på hodet.
illustrations.prompt: In a hardware shop in the shopping centre, a broad, bald smith with thick forearms and a grey leather apron stands behind the counter, holding up one hand and shaking his head, and points at a black metal bucket on the counter, which is empty. On the wall behind him hang the axes he has forged, the biggest one gleaming. The Rooster stands on the counter, pointing at it with one wing.
illustrations.caption: Smeden pekte på den svarte bøtta ved disken. Den var tom.
illustrations.alt: I jernvarehandelen rister smeden på hodet og peker på ei tom, svart bøtte på disken. Bak ham henger håndsmidde økser, og hanen peker på den største med vingen.

illustrations.prompt: Outside a small wooden kiosk by the barbecue area in the park, the Kiosk Boy has just shut the hatch and stepped out, a sack of barbecue charcoal over his shoulder and an empty bottle sticking out of his jacket pocket. He nods to the Rooster, who stands at his feet panting, his feathers ruffled and dusty. Picnic tables and a stone barbecue stand behind them in the afternoon sun.
illustrations.caption: «Kom igjen», sa han. «Du har jo ikke hender.»
illustrations.alt: Kioskgutten kommer ut av kiosken med en sekk grillkull på skulderen og en tom flaske i lomma. Han nikker til hanen, som står andpusten ved beina hans.

illustrations.anchor: Hanen spurte gutten hva han het.
illustrations.prompt: In the Nut Wood in the late afternoon sun, the Kiosk Boy kneels in the grass by the hazel bushes, still holding the water bottle. The Hen has lifted her head, bright-eyed again and shaking out her feathers. The Rooster, tired and bedraggled, stands beside her and looks up at the Kiosk Boy with his head on one side, asking him something.
illustrations.caption: Hanen spurte gutten hva han het.
illustrations.alt: Kioskgutten kneler i gresset ved hasselbuskene med vannflaska i hånda. Høna har løftet hodet og er frisk igjen, og hanen ser opp på gutten.
